title: neoregelia coriacea
intro: Neoregelia coriacea, commonly known as the "Ponytail Palm Bromeliad" or "Cane Bromeliad", is a tropical plant species in the genus Neoregelia, known for its striking, pinecone-like inflorescence. The health benefits of Neoregelia coriacea are largely anecdotal, but it is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Neoregelia coriacea.
